name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on multiple gold properties in the state of Nevada, including its Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar projects. The company is in the exploration stage and completed a 2025 reverse circulation drilling program with results announced in early 2026. Nevada is one of the world's premier gold mining jurisdictions and the company's entire portfolio is concentrated there.
